verses.en: O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
verses.pt: Vós todos os povos, batei palmas; clamai a Deus com voz de alegria.
verses.en_web: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of the sons of Korah.> O make a glad noise with your hands, all you peoples; letting your voices go up to God with joy.

verses.en: For the LORD most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.
verses.pt: Porque o SENHOR Altíssimo é temível, o grande Rei sobre toda a terra.
verses.en_web: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord Most High is to be feared; he is a great King over all the earth.

verses.en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
verses.pt: Ele subjugará aos povos debaixo de nós, e as nações debaixo de nossos pés.
verses.en_web: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
verses.en_bbe: He will put down the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.

verses.en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.pt: Ele escolhe para nós nossa herança, a glória de Jacó, a quem ele amou. (Selá)
verses.en_web: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: He will give us our heritage, the glory of Jacob who is dear to him. (Selah.)

verses.en: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.pt: Deus sobe com gritos de alegria; o SENHOR, com voz de trombeta.
verses.en_web: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
verses.en_bbe: God has gone up with a glad cry, the Lord with the sound of the horn.

verses.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
verses.pt: Cantai louvores a Deus, cantai; cantai louvores ao nosso Rei, cantai.
verses.en_web: Sing praises to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
verses.en_bbe: Give praises to God, make songs of praise; give praises to our King, make songs of praise.

verses.en: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
verses.pt: Porque Deus é o Rei de toda a terra; cantai louvores com entendimento.
verses.en_web: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
verses.en_bbe: For God is the King of all the earth; make songs of praise with knowledge.

verses.en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
verses.pt: Deus reina sobre as nações; Deus se senta sobre o trono de sua santidade.
verses.en_web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
verses.en_bbe: God is the ruler over the nations; God is on the high seat of his holy rule.

verses.en: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.
verses.pt: Os chefes dos povos se juntaram ao povo do Deus de Abraão, porque os escudos da terra pertencem a Deus, e ele é muito exaltado. Cântico e salmo, dos filhos de Coré:
verses.en_web: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
verses.en_bbe: The rulers of the peoples have come together, with the people of the God of Abraham; because the powers of the earth are God's: he is lifted up on high.
